Definition
[Elliptic space] \group ellipticSource: thurston:page-0018 Elliptic $n$-space is the quotient of the unit sphere by the antipodal involution, equivalently projective $n$-space with the induced metric. Every two points determine a unique line and the maximum distance is $\pi /2$.
